verdict.rationale: AMD documents ROCm as its official open-source GPU computing platform for Instinct hardware, which includes compilers, runtimes, libraries and the HIP C++ programming model. That is an official SDK developers can build against. Community doubt about whether the stack works in practice is general skepticism with no concrete failure, so it lowers confidence but does not create a dispute. Missing for 10: detailed per-language SDK and API reference evidence specific to the MI325X, and independent or hands-on corroboration of building against the SDK.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
